headline: Approved $241,250 retroactive pay transfer 7-1 and several grants, appointments, and license renewals.
summary: The Council held a public hearing on National Grid's petition to install underground facilities on Broadway, then closed the hearing and sent the matter to the Committee on Public Services. The Council also acted on several committee-recommended items, including grants, appointments, license renewals, and a zoning amendment, and approved a $241,250 interdepartmental transfer for retroactive union pay by a 7-1 vote. No action was taken on a request for a public meeting on Camp Paradise.
decisions: Voted 8-0 to receive and place on file the Department of Public Utilities Notice of Filing and Request for Comments (Order #121).

Approved 7-0 (Feldman absent) the reappointment of Christopher Tatnall to the Economic and Community Development Council (Order #096).
